About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 26 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.

Your mission

You will help us accelerate the growth of BlaBlaCar in France working across its three main supplies: carpools, buses, and trains.
As a Business & Marketing Intern, you’ll join a dynamic and fast-paced team at the heart of our growth strategy tackling a wide range of projects, that include both top of funnel actions and lower funnel performance strategies but also partnerships management. 
You’ll contribute to launching new initiatives, analysing performance, running campaigns, and working on impactful projects to encourage more people to use BlaBlaCar whether it is with carpool, bus or train. You will report to the Marketing Manager and work closely with teams across CRM, paid media, partnerships, and product marketing.

About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


Your Mission


We are looking for an apprentice Carpool Pricing Analyst to join our team. The Pricing mission is to fuel our marketplace growth by maximizing user success on our platform: we ensure drivers fill their empty seats at the optimal price to maximize their savings, while helping passengers find highly affordable rides. As a primary growth lever, our goal is to strategically leverage pricing by balancing volume-driven adjustments that maximize vehicle occupancy (our load strategy) with targeted initiatives that capture high-yield revenue opportunities across diverse local markets.


Your role will be to own Pricing operations, driving the daily monitoring and optimization of carpool performance worldwide through the management of our in-house Pricing tool. Additionally, you will conduct exploratory data analysis to continuously uncover new high-yield revenue streams and load-optimization opportunities. 


Working closely with local marketplace managers, Strategy and Data teams teams, this is an excellent opportunity for hands-on exposure to Product, Business, and Tech challenges at one of France's fastest-growing scale-ups.

lists.content:
• Execute Daily Pricing Monitoring: Manage the in-house pricing tool for France and Spain, manually updating recommended prices to optimize performance and capture high-yield revenue opportunities. 

  • Conduct Performance Deep-Dives & Maintenance: Perform regular analytical reviews of business rules to prevent performance decay, keep pricing strategies aligned with market trends, and handle the annual calendar setup for technical continuity.

  • Support Pricing Explorations and Carpool Growth: Monitor and analyze pricing tests, either in Western Europe or in Other countries 

  • Analyze Market Dynamics & Competition: Execute exploratory analysis on specific variables (such as the pricing behavior of new users in relation to rising fuel costs) and manage competitive tracking tools to refine benchmarking.

  • Share Learnings & Keep Pricing Up-To-Date: Organize regular performance rituals with local marketplace managers to align pricing strategies with regional business objectives, and maintain comprehensive pricing rule documentation.

• Starting or pursuing a Master's degree apprenticeship (end-of-course alternance) in an Engineering or Business course - You must be enrolled in a French school - Online schools won't be accepted

  • Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and capable of deriving synthetic insights from figures in a clear, actionable way. 

  • Eager to manage projects both from a Business and Analytical standpoint; a prior analytics or revenue management internship would be a plus. 

  • Proficiency in Gsheet/Excel is a must, and experience with SQL is a plus for autonomous data extraction and analysis. 

  • Able to coordinate and work with multidisciplinary stakeholders (esp. local marketplace managers and strategy teams). 

  • Be humble, structured, organized, highly meticulous, and possess exceptional rigor in data management and tool configuration. 

  • Enjoy working as a team-player and learning from others. 

  • Demonstrated interest in the mobility or transportation sectors. 

  • Fluency in French and English.


    • If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application!

  • Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility opportunities
  •  Regular team building events

  • A 60-min video-call with Etienne to get to know you, assess your soft skills, cultural fit, and present the team. 

  • A 60-min video-call, including an analytical task/technical case with Etienne and Riadh to assess your hard skills and meet the team.

As a Content Apprentice, your mission is to support our content team in ensuring members have a seamless and trustworthy experience. During this 1-year alternance, you will play a key role in handling daily operational and manual tasks, while actively helping us integrate and test new AI workflows to optimise our processes. You will report to our Senior Content Manager and work within our collaborative Community Relations Content team, gaining hands-on experience in modern content operations.
Your responsibilities 
Content Localisation & Maintenance: Help maintain our help center content across multiple languages by executing formatting, manual updates, and using AI-driven localisation workflows.
AI Tool Implementation: Actively test, deploy, and monitor AI agents and automated workflows to streamline daily content tasks and eliminate repetitive manual work.
Project Assistance: Support Content Specialists on end-to-end projects, taking ownership of execution steps, data entry, and stakeholder delivery.
Documentation & Asset Management: Keep our internal guidelines, prompt libraries, and process documentation up to date as our workflows evolve.
Your qualifications 
Currently pursuing a Degree/Master’s degree in Communications, Linguistics, Translation, Digital Business, or a related field (eligible for a 1-year contrat d’apprentissage or de professionnalisation). Must be in person in France (no online or abroad schools). 
Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal); proficiency in other languages is a plus.
A tech-savvy mindset and a genuine passion for AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, automation tools, etc.), with a curiosity for building and testing AI agents.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling repetitive operational tasks with rigor.
Resourceful, agile, and quick to learn new software, tools, and changing digital environments.
A strong team player with a "can-do" attitude and a willingness to help wherever needed.
Nice to have: Previous internship or project experience in content writing, translation, or digital operations.

Hybrid working mode - 2 days per week at the Office in Bastille, Paris
Financial support for home office equipment
4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves
50% healthcare coverage (Alan)
Minimum 25 days holiday per year
Local meal plan policy (Swile card)
 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility opportunities

About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


Your mission
As the Localization Operations Specialist, you will own the day-to-day localization run that keeps BlaBlaCar's product speaking 40+ locales across Android, iOS, and web. Your mission is to take full ownership of the recurring translation loop, from request intake to delivery, so that content reaches travelers in every market quickly, accurately, and on schedule.
You will run an AI-assisted localization pipeline end to end: triaging incoming requests, producing translations through our AI tooling, staging them for linguist review, and delivering them to the live product. You will be the operational backbone of the function during a period of automation and growth, holding the run reliably while the longer-term AI and strategy work moves forward in parallel.
You will work hand-in-hand with the Senior Localization Project Manager, who owns the assets, pipelines, and strategy, and partner closely with developers, Product Managers, content designers, and external linguists to keep the localization machine running smoothly.
 
Your responsibilities
Own the daily/weekly localization run: Take full ownership of the recurring loop — intake and triage of requests (Jira tickets and ad-hoc spreadsheets), AI translation through our tooling, staging for linguist review, and delivery to the product.
Run linguist review and job management: Handle the weekly review cycle — creating and grouping translation jobs, overseeing the automated publish, and answering linguist questions by tracing each string back to its source and closing the loop with the right person.
Run the monthly product content review: Coordinate the recurring review of live product strings — routing them to the per-locale reviewers, collecting their changes, and applying them back.
Keep quality high: Run the QA pass on each batch, act on validation flags (placeholders, plurals, do-not-translate terms), and fix reported localization bugs, both functional (truncation, layout, broken placeholders) and linguistic.
Support developers and product teams: Handle everyday content requests in the translation management system and answer string-context questions. Monitor the localization and content channels for incoming issues.
Track the work: Keep the content and word-count trackers up to date so every request is accounted for through delivery, and support the related reporting.
 
Your qualifications
Experience: Prior experience in localization, translation operations, or a content / project-coordination role in a tech or scale-up environment. Comfortable owning a recurring operational process end to end.
Tools & process: Hands-on with a TMS (Phrase a strong plus) and comfortable working inside ticketing and tracking tools (Jira, spreadsheets). Quick to learn new operator tooling.
AI fluency: Comfortable working with AI tools day to day and confident reviewing their output critically rather than taking it at face value. General AI fluency matters more here than a specific tool.
Rigor & autonomy: Highly organized and reliable under a fixed weekly cadence. Able to run the loop solo and flag issues early.
Languages: Full fluency in English is mandatory. French is a plus.
 
The team
The Localization function: A lean, heavily AI-assisted localization operation covering 40+ locales across all platforms, sitting within Product & Experience.
Your role in it: You own the run. The Senior Localization Project Manager owns the linguistic assets, the AI pipelines and tooling, vendor and budget strategy, and the localization roadmap — with a handover gradient where some judgment-heavy items shift to you as you ramp.
External stakeholders: The external linguist roster and translation vendors.
Internal stakeholders: Developers, Product Managers, content designers, and the wider Product organization.
 
What we have to offer
This role is on a 4-months CDD contract from September to December, part time 3 days a week. 
4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves
50% healthcare coverage (Alan)
Minimum 25 days holiday per year 
Local meal plan policy (Swile card)
50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)
Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides
Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility programs
Regular team building events
1 day off per year to test our product
 
Interested in joining the ride?
A 45-minutes screening call with Barbara Carnet, Talent Acquisition Manager, to get to know you and answer your first questions.
A 1-hour interview with Simon Rimbert, Senior Localization Project Manager, to deep dive into the role, your experience, and how you'd run the localization loop.

Your mission
 
As the Senior Product Manager for the Payment squad, you will lead the evolution of our global transaction engine, ensuring a seamless and reliable experience for millions of travelers. Your mission is to build a robust, scalable payment infrastructure that supports BlaBlaCar’s multimodal and international growth. You will be responsible for optimizing every step of the payment lifecycle—from checkout conversion and authorization rates to payout flows and fraud prevention.
You will play a strategic role in transforming our payment landscape, moving toward a flexible and resilient architecture. This involves integrating diverse local payment methods, enhancing our promotional capabilities through advanced discount systems, and streamlining financial operations. By bridging technical complexity with user-centric design, you will remove transactional friction and directly contribute to the company's profitability and global scale.
You will co-lead the squad with an Engineering Manager and partner closely with Finance, Product Operations, Data, and other Product leaders to align our payment infrastructure with the company's broader strategic priorities.
Your responsibilities
 
Shape the payment strategy & roadmap: Define the long-term vision, success metrics, and product roadmap for BlaBlaCar’s global transaction engine. Secure strong alignment from leadership and cross-functional partners to ensure our infrastructure scales with multimodal and international growth.
Enable strategic payment capabilities: Lead product discovery and delivery for high-stakes, revenue-driving features. This encompasses both infrastructure evolutions—such as driving the product strategy for our multi-PSP payment orchestrator and scalable routing rules in tandem with Product Operations —and business-facing capabilities like launching local payment methods, advanced promotional/discount systems, and subscription models.
Own payment performance & KPIs: Establish internal targets and drive cross-functional alignment to monitor core transaction health. Be accountable for maximizing authorization rates and transaction reliability across all 18 locales.
Drive bottom-line impact via funnel optimization: Deeply analyze the end-to-end checkout and payout flows. Continuously optimize passenger checkout and driver payout experiences by identifying initiatives that eliminate technical friction, reduce technical errors, decrease time-to-resolution, and minimize operational costs.
Navigate complex stakeholder alignment: Drive alignment across a matrix of internal teams (including Finance, Legal, Customer Care, and Product Operations), balancing a frictionless user experience with compliance, internal priorities, and legal frameworks. 
Cultivate strategic partnerships with global and local Payment Service Providers to stay ahead of fintech trends and ensure top-tier infrastructure performance.
Oversee technical integrations & squad execution: Co-lead execution hand-in-hand with your Engineering Manager and a full-stack squad of 10 engineers, translating complex architectural shifts into deliverable MVPs and overseeing complex technical integrations.
Your qualifications
 
Experience: 5+ years of Product Management in a scale-up or large tech company, with direct experience in Fintech or Payments (PSPs, financial flows, orchestration).

About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


Your Mission
 
We are looking for a People Operations Specialist to join the People Operations team at BlaBlaCar. 
 
As a People Ops Specialist, you will manage the day-to-end employee lifecycle for Blablacar’s employees based in France. As part of a team, you will ensure full legal compliance in France, while providing prompt, effective support for all employee inquiries. By maintaining our HRIS and formalizing contractual elements, you will act as a key guardian of our data integrity and internal policies. This role is essential in streamlining our onboarding journey and optimizing HR processes to support our team.
 
Your Responsibilities 
 
• Lead the execution of HR processes (Onboarding → Offboarding), ensuring a positive experience while providing clear visibility to relevant stakeholders
• Formalize all contractual elements (contracts, amendments, certificates) and manage immigration/work permit renewals
• Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and lead People Ops projects aimed at enhancing efficiency
• Explore and implement AI-driven solutions to automate repetitive administrative tasks (e.g., automated document generation, AI-powered ticketing sorting, or smart data auditing) to free up time for high-value advisory
• Manage employee inquiries (JIRA), providing prompt, effective support on HR policies
• Provide expert recommendations for handling complex situations (performance, conflict, legal risk). 
• Document specific requests to ensure every situation is tracked and treated fairly, building a consistent "Case Law" for the organization
• Work closely with the POPS team including our Payroll Specialist (upstream data flows), HRBPs, Social Expert, Recruiters, and L&D to ensure a cohesive employee experience.
• Actively participate in team meetings, sharing insights and contributing to a supportive, high-performance team environment
 
Your Qualifications 
 
• +4 years of experience in a People Operations, HR Coordinator, or HR Generalist role, ideally within a fast-paced environment in France
• Proficiency with HRIS platforms (e.g., BambooHR, Workday…), Google Workspace and strong project management skills
• Good knowledge of French social legislation (SYNTEC would be a plus)
• Great communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to clearly articulate HR policies and respond to employee inquiries with empathy and professionalism
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively
• Problem-solving aptitude, curiosity and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
• Full working proficiency in English and French
 
What we have to offer
 
• Hybrid status for this role : 2-3 days at the Office
• 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves
• 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)
• Financial support for home office equipment
• Minimum 25 days holiday per year 
• Local meal plan policy (Swile card)
• 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)
• Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides
• Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility programs
• Employee Stock ownership plan
• Regular team building events
• 1 day off per year to test our product
• 1 day per year for social engagements with non-profits
 
Interested in joining the ride?
 
• a 45-min video-call with your Talent Acquisition Manager to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions
• a 45-min interview with your future manager Margaux Swanda, People Operations Manager, to discuss your interest in the role and your career expectations
• a fully remote exercise to evaluate your technical skills
• a 60-min interview with Margaux and Marie-Christine People Operations Specialist, to review the business case and to check team-fit
 
 
Our hiring process lasts on average 25-30 days, offers usually come within 48 hours.

À propos de BlaBlaCar
BlaBlaCar est la première communauté mondiale de covoiturage et de voyage en bus, rassemblant plus de 26 millions de membres chaque année dans 40 pays. Nos 1000 collaborateurs, issus de plus de 50 nationalités, sont répartis dans 5 bureaux internationaux, avec 30 % de l’équipe en télétravail complet.
Rejoindre BlaBlaCar, c’est participer à une aventure humaine et technologique unique, au service d’une mission : rendre la mobilité partagée plus accessible, conviviale et durable.
Ta mission
Au sein de l’équipe Business & Marketing France, tu intégreras une équipe dédiée à la croissance de la communauté BlaBlaCar et tu travailleras sur des problématiques diverses et les différentes business unit de BlaBlaCar (covoiturage, bus, train). 
Tu intégreras l’équipe Marketing France et tu auras un rôle clé dans l’animation de nos réseaux sociaux pour engager la communauté BlaBlaCar. En lien avec l’agence spécialisée et en collaboration avec le Marketing Manager, tu contribueras à développer la notoriété et l’attractivité de la marque, avec un focus particulier sur TikTok et les nouvelles tendances sur les réseaux sociaux. Tu participeras aussi au déploiement de stratégies pour développer l’attractivité de BlaBlaCar auprès de la communauté étudiant.e.s.. 
Date de début: Dès septembre
Tes responsabilités 
Participer au développement de la stratégie de contenus pour nos réseaux sociaux (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.) en lien avec le Marketing Manager.
Proposer, créer, publier du contenu engageant (vidéos, stories, formats innovants) et agir en tant que community manager
 Identifier et exploiter les tendances TikTok et les adapter aux codes de BlaBlaCar.
Suivre et analyser les performances des campagnes (reach, engagement, conversions).
Collaborer avec les équipes Brand, Design et CRM pour amplifier les campagnes.
Participer à la veille concurrentielle et sectorielle : tendances en mobilité, usages des réseaux sociaux, bonnes pratiques de community management.
Soutenir ponctuellement les campagnes marketing locales (CRM, activations offline/online).
Ton profil
Tu es actuellement en Master 1 ou 2 (École de commerce, Université ou équivalent).
Tu disposes d’une première expérience en marketing ou en gestion de réseaux sociaux.
Tu es passionné par les médias sociaux, avec une forte appétence pour TikTok et ses codes.
Tu es créatif(ve), curieux(se), et force de proposition pour imaginer des contenus impactants.
Tu es structuré(e), organisé(e) et capable de gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle.
Tu t’exprimes parfaitement en français et tu es à l’aise en anglais (oral et écrit).
Tu es basé(e) à Paris (ou prêt(e) à y travailler).
Tu maîtrises les outils de travail classiques (Canva, Powerpoint, Excel…) et tu sauras vite t’adapter aux outils réseaux sociaux (Outils de planification, Montage Video…)
